'''Port Sarim''' is a small port in south-eastern [[Asgarnia]]. The port connects to a number of other ports, including [[Entrana]], [[Karamja]], [[Crandor]], [[Great Kourend]], [[Corsair Cove]], and the [[Void Knights' Outpost]], as well as even more destinations via [[charter ship]].

==Transportation==
Several transport options bring players into or close to Port Sarim, listed here with their arrival destination.

* {{Plink|Spirit trees|pic=Spirit tree (Construction) icon}} — northern Port Sarim.
* {{plink|Charter ships|pic=War ship}} — Port Sarim docks.
* {{plink|Minigame Teleport}} — [[Rat Pits]] or [[Void Knights' Outpost]]. Usable once every 20 minutes.
* {{plink|Pest control teleport}} — [[Void Knights' Outpost]], where the [[Squire (Void Knights)|squire]] can take  players to Port Sarim for free.
* {{Plink|Explorer's ring 2}} — the [[South Falador Farm|farm just north of the pub]].
* {{Plink|Amulet of glory}} — [[Draynor Village]], east of the port.
* {{Plink|Draynor Manor Teleport}} — [[Draynor Manor]], north-east of the port.
* {{Plink|Ring of the elements}} — [[Air Altar]] entrance, north of the port.
* {{Plink|Teleport to House}} — [[Rimmington]] [[house portal]]. Requires a [[POH]] in Rimmington.
* {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|aiq}} — [[Mudskipper Point]], well south of the port.
* {{Plink|Falador Teleport}} — centre of [[Falador]], well north of the port.
* {{Plink|Teleport to Boat}} — Port Sarim [[File:Docking_point_icon.png]] [[mooring point]]. Requires [[Boat|player-owned boat]] with a [[Greater_teleport_focus_(facility)|greater teleport focus]] installed docked at the [[Gangplank (Sailing)|gangplank]].

Players can also get thrown into the holding cell at [[Shantay Pass]] and refuse to pay the fine for a one-way trip to the [[Port Sarim jail]]. Talk to [[Shantay]] and tell him you are an outlaw; once in Port Sarim jail, click the "pick-lock" option on the door to escape.

==Locations==
=== Port Sarim docks ===
The Port Sarim docks connect the port to a number of ports across [[Gielinor]]:

{{Charter ship fares}}

[[Trader Stan]] and crew can be found on the southernmost jetty of the docks. They have many things to trade, and will allow members to use the [[charter ship]]s to travel to many other ports. After completing [[Cabin Fever]], the charter ship fare is reduced by 50%. Wearing the [[Ring of Charos(a)]] also reduces the fare by 50%. These two bonuses can be stacked to reduce the cost to 25%.
[[File:Port Sarim jail toilet.png|thumb|A close-up of one of the cells in the [[Port Sarim jail]].]]

=== Buildings ===
{| class="wikitable"
!Name
!Description
|-
|[[Betty's Magic Emporium]]
|Found on the north-western most part of the port. [[Betty]] runs the store, and sells [[Magic]] [[items]]. Players may purchase [[runes]], [[eye of newt]]s, and blue and black [[wizard hat]]s.
|-
|[[Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar]]
|Located east of [[Grum's Gold Exchange]]. [[Brian]] runs the store and sells [[battleaxe]]s. Players may purchase battleaxes from [[bronze battleaxe|bronze]] to [[adamant battleaxe|adamant]], including [[black battleaxe|black]], though the higher tiered battleaxes are usually sold out.
|-
|[[South Falador Farm|Falador farm]]
|A farm between Port Sarim and [[Falador]], with [[chicken]]s, [[cow]]s, a [[Sarah's Farming Shop|farming shop]], a number of [[Farming/Patch locations|farming patches]]. and a [[loom]].
|-
|[[Gerrant's Fishy Business]]
|[[Gerrant]] runs the store and sells raw [[fish]] and [[fishing]] equipment. Players may purchase all [[free-to-play]] fishing equipment here, [[fishing bait]], [[feather]]s, and raw fish that are available to free-to-play players from [[Raw shrimps|shrimps]] all the way to [[Raw swordfish|swordfish]]. On the north wall of the store, a [[white apron]] [[Spawning|spawns]].
|-
|[[Grum's Gold Exchange]]
|Located directly south of [[Betty's Magic Emporium]]. [[Grum]] runs the store and sells various [[jewellery]]. Players can purchase [[ring]]s, [[necklace]]s, and strung [[amulet]]s. The store is stocked only by other players selling their jewellery.
|-
|[[Port Sarim jail]]
|A large jail.
|-
|[[Rimmington church]]
|An [[altar]] can be found inside the church. Many players use this altar on their way to the [[Asgarnian Ice Dungeon]].
|-
|[[Wydin's Food Store]]
|A store owned by [[Wydin]], which sells various [[food]] [[items]]. The store plays an important role in the [[Pirate's Treasure]] [[quest]].
|}

===Other===
* Just north-west of the port is a small meadow featuring the necromancer [[Malignius Mortifer]] and his four apprentices.
* South of the port is [[Mudskipper Point]], the home of [[Thurgo]], the entrance to the [[Asgarnian Ice Dungeon]], and the [[Slayer]] location for [[mogre]]s.
* Players can also find the [[Rimmington mine]] just west of the port.

==Sailing info==
Players can [[mooring point|dock]] at Port Sarim with level 1 [[Sailing]]. The southernmost dock offers the following utilities for sailors:
*[[File:Shipwright map icon.png|link=Shipwright]] [[Shipwright]]
*[[File:Port task board icon.png|link=Notice board]] [[Notice board]]
*[[File:Salvaging station map icon.png|link=Salvaging station]] [[Salvaging station]]
*[[File:Ledger table icon.png|link=Ledger table]] [[Ledger table]]
*[[File:Crew registrar_icon.png|link=Crew registrar]] [[Crew Registrar]]
*[[File:Bank icon.png|link=Bank deposit box]] [[Bank deposit box]]

==Inhabitants==

===Personalities===

* {{Chatl|Ahab}}, a man drinking [[Ahab's beer|his beer]] in the [[Rusty Anchor Inn]].
* {{Chatl|Barman (Ratpit bar)|txt=Barman}}, a man selling [[stew]] and [[beer]] in the [[Rat Pits]].
* {{Chatl|Bartender (Rusty Anchor Inn)|txt=Bartender}}, a gossiping seller of beer.
* {{Chatl|Bellemorde}}, a standoffish cat who keeps The Face company outside the [[Rat Pits]].
* {{Chatl|Betty}}, a magician who runs [[Betty's Magic Emporium]].
* {{Chatl|Brian}}, a weapons-seller.
* {{Chatl|Cap'n Hand}}, an imprisoned pirate.
* {{Chatl|Captain Tobias}}, a captain who can bring players to [[Musa Point]] or [[The Pandemonium]].
* {{Chatl|Captain Tock}}, a pirate captain who starts [[The Corsair Curse]] quest.
* {{Chatl|The Face|pic=The Face chathead}}, who patrols the entrance to the Rat Pits.
* {{Chatl|Felkrash}}, a cat aficionado who can name cats and turn them into [[Wily cat|wily cats]] if they're [[Overgrown cat|overgrown]].
* {{Chatl|Frizzy Skernip}}, a gnome who looks after the [[spirit tree patch]].
* 5 {{Chatl|gamer|pic=Gamer (Green) chathead}}s, who bet in the [[Rat Pits]].
* {{Chatl|Gerrant}}, a  fisherman who runs [[Gerrant's Fishy Business]].
* {{Chatl|Grum}}, a jewellery merchant who runs [[Grum's Gold Exchange]].
* 6 {{Chatl|Guard (Port Sarim)|txt=guards}},  including [[Guard (Port Sarim, sleeping)|one who is sleeping]]
* {{Chatl|Jack Seagull}}, a pirate in the Rusty Anchor Inn who tells players of [[Fossil Island]].
* {{Chatl|Jobless Jim}}, the lowest-level [[Crew Management|crewmate]] available.
* {{Chatl|Klarense}}, a sailor who sells players his boat, the ''[[Lady Lumbridge]]''.
* {{Chatl|Longbow Ben}}, a pirate in the Rusty Anchor Inn who helps adventurers find new quests.
* {{Chatl|Malignius Mortifer}}, a necromancer who appears in several quests.
* 3 {{Chatl|Monk of Entrana|txt=monks of Entrana|pic=Monk of Entrana (1) chathead}}, who make sure the player has no items on them before visiting [[Entrana|the holy island]].
* {{Chatl|Port master#Port Sarim|txt=Port master|pic=Port master (Port Sarim) chathead}}, who helps players with their [[port tasks]].
* {{Chatl|Redbeard Frank}}, a pirate who starts the [[Pirate's Treasure]] quest.
* {{Chatl|Seaman Lorris}}, a sailor who can bring players to [[Musa Point]] or [[The Pandemonium]].
* {{Chatl|Seaman Thresnor}}, a sailor who can bring players to [[Musa Point]] or [[The Pandemonium]].
* {{Chatl|Security Guard|txt=Security guard}}, who offers players insight on staying safe online.
* {{Chatl|Shipwright Sam}}, who helps players customise their [[Boat|boats]].
* {{Chatl|Squire (Void Knights)#Female (Port Sarim)|txt=Squire|pic=Squire (Void Knights) chathead}}, who will take players to the [[Void Knights' Outpost]].
* {{Chatl|Tool Leprechaun|txt=Tool leprechaun}}, a green-clad fellow who can store gardening supplies and note produce.
* 2 {{Chatl|Trader crewmember|txt=trader crewmembers|pic=Trader Crewmember (1) chathead}}, who help Trader Stan
* {{Chatl|Trader Stan}}, who owns the [[Charter ship|charter ships]] on the docks.
* {{Chatl|Veos}}, a mysterious treasure hunter. After [[A Kingdom Divided]], Veos is replaced by {{Chatl|Cabin Boy Herbert}}.
* {{Chatl|Wormbrain}}, a goblin who holds part of [[Lozar]]'s part of the [[Crandor map]].
* {{Chatl|Wydin}}, an oblivious man who runs the [[Food Store|food store]].

[[Turbogroomer]] and [[Pusskins]] can also be found fighting with rats in the Rat Pits.
